reels.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10

editorial_notes.reasoning: Higgsfield represents a significant jump in generative video duration, tapping into the high-velocity 'multimodal_diffusion' trend while offering perfect opportunities for 3b1b-style geometric visualizations of temporal consistency.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could generate an entire short film from a single prompt instead of just a five-second clip?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A 'flip-book' that grows from a few pages to a thick novel, where the animator ensures the character’s shirt pattern stays identical across every single page.
